gbm_population_evidence.quote: Have radiographic suspicion of newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM).

candidate_evidence.quote: TMZ (Chemotherapy) is used as a first-line treatment, often in combination with radiation therapy after surgical resection of the tumor

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Have radiographic suspicion of newly diagnosed glioblastoma (GBM).

role_evidence.quote: TMZ will be administered at a dose of 75 mg/m2/day orally for each Arm.

arms: Maximal safe resection followed by EBRT with concurrent TMZ followed by adjuvant TMZ (Arm A)
Maximal safe resection + GammaTile followed by EBRT with concurrent TMZ then adjuvant TMZ (Arm B)

source_quote.quote: A previous biopsy diagnosis other than IDH wild-type GBM.

coder_notes: Experimental intervention is a device (GammaTile, Cs-131 brachytherapy) plus modified EBRT fractionation; temozolomide is identical in both arms. No pharmacological candidate. IDH wild-type used to define GBM (never candidate-matched). Arm A is registered ACTIVE_COMPARATOR.
